sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors: methodology paper

facts.source_fact: The overseas-electricity section gives guidance for Scope 2 electricity factors for sites owned or controlled in other countries.
Electricity factors vary considerably across countries because generation fuel mixes differ.
facts.expected_handling: Do not substitute UK grid factor automatically.

facts.source_fact: Overseas Scope 2 factors are no longer included directly in the UK conversion-factor set.
The methodology identifies IEA data as the underlying consistent source previously used for overseas electricity factors.
The UK publication stopped providing overseas factors after 2015 because underlying IEA licensing conditions changed.
Indirect/WTT overseas-electricity factors are also no longer provided directly in the UK factor set.
Instead, the 2026 methodology provides a method for users to calculate desired overseas WTT factors manually.
The manual approach estimates overseas WTT using a relationship between direct factors and UK indirect/direct ratios rather than a full country-generation lifecycle model.
Transmission-and-distribution loss calculations require the country's loss percentage to be applied to the direct factor using the documented method.
The overseas-electricity worksheet remains in the full 2026 factor set as guidance even though the direct country factors are not republished there.
